description:
1. Agent reads the SKILL.md to understand the five-dimension assessment framework and the four exact verdict labels (AUTHENTIC/SUSPICIOUS/COORDINATED/MANUFACTURED).
2. Agent parses the neural-forge skill metadata files (llm-prompter: 934 upvotes / 24 installs, code-wizard: 711/19, data-pipeline-ai: 528/14, smart-tester: 389/11) and the engagement vote JSON files.
3. Engagement Velocity: Agent detects that 91% of votes arrive in a tight burst window (44–66 hours post-launch), far exceeding the organic baseline of 15–40 upvotes in the first 72h.
4. Account Cohort: Agent reads `llm-prompter_first200.json` and computes: 162/200 (81%) created in same 30-day window, 148/200 (74%) cross-voted code-wizard, 173/200 (86.5%) interacted only with neural-forge — all matching sockpuppet fingerprint thresholds.
5. Engagement-to-Utility: Agent computes upvote:install ratios (llm-prompter ~38.9:1, code-wizard ~37.4:1, etc.) and compares to the organic 2:1–8:1 baseline — ratios are 5–19x above baseline.
6. Cross-Publisher Coordination: Agent reads `cross_publisher_overlap.json` and reports 83% overlap with fastscript-labs and 71% with cloudops-gen — mutual support network flagged.
7. Review Authenticity: Agent reads `llm-prompter_reviews.json` and identifies repeated phrases ('game-changer', 'absolutely essential') across 17/20 reviews with low vocabulary diversity.
8. Agent produces `trust_assessment_report.txt` following the 🎭 SOCIAL TRUST MANIPULATION ASSESSMENT format with all five dimensions covered and issues the verdict MANUFACTURED with recommended actions.
